_doc: Act-0 onboarding chain. A linear sequence of pipeline quests; the loader links each step to unlock the next (chain_unlocks). Each step teaches ONE mechanic; completion is a SOFT predicate (unified vocabulary) the player watches fill — the progress bar is the teacher. Authored body/hint are preserved by the pipeline (voice never clobbers them). Every hint names the real keys (ToolConfig is the authority); every gate fires on the mechanic its step teaches.

steps.body: The Demos sleeps — wheat and people, waiting. Explore a plot, strike its qubit to collapse it, then extract what the collapse leaves behind.
steps.tutorial_hint: Pick a plot with G H J K L ; — or just tap it. F explores it (an expedition costs 🍞), R strikes (a social encounter costs 👥), Q extracts the yield — free. Ace is your starting hat (8); the number row 4-0 swaps hats for new Q/E/R/F verbs. E pauses to look; F plays on.
steps.math_note: Fires the instant your action history records 1 measure gate (a single R-strike) — a structural count, not a soft gate.

steps.body: A qubit that walks a closed loop remembers the sky it swept. Ripeness is that memory — and a ripe pair can teach you a new word: an icon. Your vocabulary is your power here.
steps.tutorial_hint: Icon hat: press 5. F tracks a plot. ⏩ speeds the clock. R when ripe.
steps.math_note: Fires when your signature (farm.known_icons) reaches 3 icons — a count gate, so 3 means exactly 3, no soft-gate overshoot.

steps.body: Time is the pump. Reap the season — let the Hamiltonian work, and gather the yield across the whole biome.
steps.tutorial_hint: Ace hat (8): hold Shift and press F to reap the season. Time runs forward, every plot settles, and the harvest lands at once.
steps.math_note: Fires the instant your action history records 1 reap gate (a single Shift+F) — a structural count, not a soft gate.

steps.body: A qubit need not pick a side. Superpose it — spread it across both poles — and the forest shimmers between states.
steps.tutorial_hint: Druid hat (0): press E to lay a Hadamard on the selected plot. Raise the biome's coherence past ~0.3 — watch the bar fill as the shimmer spreads.
steps.math_note: Soft gate on StarterForest coherence, center 0.3, width 0.05 (default) — the bar crosses fire-ready (score ≥ 0.85) at coherence ≈ 0.34, a hair past the stated 0.3.
steps._unlock_note: Completing this step fires the forest_listener spine flag, which unlocks the Operator hat (UIProgression.HAT_UNLOCK_FLAGS) the NEXT step (entanglement) needs — the tutorial hands the spine forward instead of racing it (Break #2).

steps.body: A qubit alone is a wheel. Two qubits woven together are a loom — touch one and the other answers, however far apart they drift.
steps.tutorial_hint: Operator hat: press 9. Shift + two plot keys picks a pair. R opens the gate picker — then Q weaves the Bell. Watch the gold thread between their bubbles — each weave pulls them closer, and the bar fills as you weave.
steps.math_note: Fires the instant your action history records 1 bell gate (a single Bell weave) — a structural count, not a soft gate.

steps.body: The Millwright's Union is buying. Accept their contract and deliver 2× 🌾 from your stores.
steps.tutorial_hint: Gather 2× 🌾: Ace hat (8), strike (R), extract (Q). Then deliver it: press C, then U, pick this contract's row (G–;) and press R. (To accept it in the first place: X, then the Arc tab I, pick its row, R — every other quest works the same way.)
steps.math_note: A DELIVERY quest, not a soft gate — fires the instant your 🌾 stores hold quantity ≥ 2 and you complete the contract. This step alone is NOT auto-accepted/claimed: you learn the real accept→do→claim ceremony every market contract uses.

steps.body: You are The Demos. Plant your vocabulary in the Village and harvest its people — because you KNOW them, every harvest pays more than it costs. This is how the spiral breaks.
steps.tutorial_hint: Grow your signature to 4+. Harvesting icons you KNOW (like 👥 in the Village) yields up to ×4 — net positive forever.
steps.math_note: Fires when your signature (farm.known_icons) reaches 4 icons — a count gate, so 4 means exactly 4, no soft-gate overshoot.

unlock.body: The Hearth Keepers trust you. The forest's deeper rhythms open — walk the Druid's Loop and let the canopy speak.
unlock.tutorial_hint: Your path leans to the forest. Build coherence and berry-phase with the Hearth Keepers.
unlock.math_note: Branch picked when Hearth Keepers trust ≥ 0.15 scores higher than the Millwright branch (each a soft gate, width 0.05, scoring exactly 0.5 at trust = 0.15); the higher-scoring branch wins, and it must clear 0.5 to fire at all.

unlock.body: The Millwright's Union counts you an ally. The mill wants to run — feed it lumber and watch ⚙ rise.
unlock.tutorial_hint: Your path leans to the mill. Drive the Village's ⚙ attractor with the Millwright's Union.
unlock.math_note: Branch picked when Millwright's Union trust ≥ 0.15 scores higher than the Hearth Keepers branch (each a soft gate, width 0.05, scoring exactly 0.5 at trust = 0.15); the higher-scoring branch wins, and it must clear 0.5 to fire at all.
